actionEffects.note: docs/04 §6.4 care-action effect matrix for continuous actions. RESOLVES removes the cause's distress while the action runs; PARTIAL scales it by partialReliefFactor; WORSENS by worsenFactor. Feeding resolves hunger by intake and adds gas. Instant actions are in engine code (docs/04 §14).

partialReliefFactor.note: A PARTIAL effect scales a cause's distress by this while the action runs.
